findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_niner_tools, google_reviews_insights, app_store_intelligence, amazon_reviews_scraper, etsy_scraper, b2b_lead_list_builder · Private data: ai_company_enrichment, crypto_market_intelligence, serp_intelligence, website_to_markdown, contact_page_extractor, dataset_contact_enricher, domain_whois_intelligence, b2b_crm_enricher, b2b_lead_list_builder, google_maps_lead_enricher, nordic_maps_enricher · Public sink: ai_share_of_voice, ai_search_visibility_platform, ai_cold_email_personalizer, tweet_sentiment_intelligence, dataset_contact_enricher, ai_prospecting_pipeline, b2b_cold_outreach_sequencer, b2b_email_verifier, b2b_outbound_engine, email_finder_scraper, google_maps_lead_enricher, b2b_job_post_parser · Destructive: ai_prospecting_pipeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_niner_tools, google_reviews_insights, app_store_intelligence, amazon_reviews_scraper, etsy_scraper, b2b_lead_list_builder · Private data: ai_company_enrichment, crypto_market_intelligence, serp_intelligence, website_to_markdown, contact_page_extractor, dataset_contact_enricher, domain_whois_intelligence, b2b_crm_enricher, b2b_lead_list_builder, google_maps_lead_enricher, nordic_maps_enricher · Public sink: ai_share_of_voice, ai_search_visibility_platform, ai_cold_email_personalizer, tweet_sentiment_intelligence, dataset_contact_enricher, ai_prospecting_pipeline, b2b_cold_outreach_sequencer, b2b_email_verifier, b2b_outbound_engine, email_finder_scraper, google_maps_lead_enricher, b2b_job_post_parser · Destructive: ai_prospecting_pipeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
